purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: TKGM describes the free public parcel-query map; users can locate parcels by administrative parcel identifiers or map location. The official Hatay Metropolitan Municipality announced its Kent Rehberi parcel-search tool in May 2026. A single bounded anonymous API request at the exact WUP point (36.2147772245554, 36.157969070235) to the public MEGSIS coordinate endpoint returned HTTP 403 with the official viewer Referer/Origin; no parcel geometry or identifiers were received. No retry using credentials or alternate proxy was made.
registryAssessment: TKGM is the national cadastral authority providing the official public parcel-query service, and Hatay Metropolitan Municipality confirms local parcel search in its city guide.
